label: The contract with the simulator
subgoals: Return terminal currents, charges and their voltage derivatives
Keep every quantity smooth across operating regions
Derive capacitances from terminal charges to conserve charge

label: Formulations and qualification
subgoals: Classify a model by its core variable: threshold, surface potential or inversion charge
Require one parameter set to scale across geometry and temperature
Run symmetry and derivative tests in addition to current fits

label: Engineering a compact model
subgoals: Weigh evaluation cost per call against accuracy
Prefer physics-based expressions to raw tables for smoothness and extrapolation
Respect the qualified range and include noise and parasitics
